subject: Cardinal Bio — environment fork + capacity surge at renewal
messages:
From: Ellie Tran <ellie.tran@cardinalbio.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cardinalbio.com>, Cardinal Bio Procurement <procurement@cardinalbio.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal questions + adding isolated analytics cluster

Hi Soojin —

We’re starting renewal discussions for our Redwood Private footprint (renewal window mid-May). A couple of asks from engineering and procurement:

1) We need an isolated analytics cluster (air-gapped network segment) spun up alongside our primary VPC at renewal — essentially an environment fork for analytics / DS work.
2) We expect a short-term, high-throughput spike for model retraining in July (2–3 week burst) and want burst-reserve nodes we can enable temporarily.
3) Procurement expects to understand term/proration implications if we add a new environment at renewal and whether we can push part of the capacity into a 12-month commit while keeping some on pay-as-you-go.

Can you share a recommended plan (timeline, pricing delta, any SLA exceptions we need to document)? Also please send the draft SOW and a simple pricing matrix we can share internally.

Thanks,
Ellie

Ellie Tran
Head of Platform Engineering
Cardinal Bio
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Tran <ellie.tran@cardinalbio.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cardinalbio.com>, Cardinal Bio Procurement <procurement@cardinalbio.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal questions + adding isolated analytics cluster

Ellie —

Thanks, this is straightforward to support. High-level plan below; attaching draft SOW and a pricing matrix for the add-on.

Summary plan (can be treated as a MAP to get procurement + infra aligned):
- Target cut: week of 2027-05-17 (aligned with your renewal).
- New environment: "analytics-isolated" (VPC fork + dedicated cluster, network ACLs + customer-provided peering config). Estimated baseline: 3 nodes (A100s equivalent), buffer to scale to 8 nodes for burst.
- Burst reserve: pre-provisioned burst pool (3 nodes) that can be enabled for 2–3 weeks; billed as reservation + overage if used.
- Term/Proration: we can split capacity: commit 6 nodes on a 12-mo reserved contract (start date 2027-05-17) and keep remaining nodes pay-as-you-go; proration window will be handled on the invoice for the month where the reserved capacity begins. Legal will need to sign the SOW addendum to reflect the split billing model.
- SLA: standard Private SLA applies; if you want guaranteed burst capacity, we’ll include an exception clause that guarantees access to the pre-provisioned pool during the defined window — that requires a 15% uplift to the reservation price.

Next steps I propose:
1) Review attached SOW (high-level scoping).
2) Procurement: confirm if Cardinal prefers the 12-month commit on the whole new environment or split commit (we recommend split).
3) I’ll loop in Ben (AE) + Kimberly (Solutions Eng) to finalize sizing and any network constraints.

Attached: Cardinal_SOW_env-fork_v1.pdf, pricing_matrix_cardinal_v2.xlsx, proposed_network_diagram.png

I’ll follow up with the internal ask to get approvals and pricing concession requests.

—So
Soojin Lee
Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Cardinal Bio renewal — need pricing approval & SE check (env fork + burst)

Ben / Kimberly —

Looping you both in on Cardinal Bio (deal RBW-2027-042). Ellie asked to add an isolated analytics environment at renewal and a short-term burst reserve in July. Attachments are in the thread.

What I need:
- Ben: confirmation on list price and room for a concession (Cardinal is asking for a 10% discount on the reserved portion if we do the full 12-mo commit). Recommend we offer 7% + extended invoice terms instead of straight 10%?
- Kimberly: confirm network constraints — they’ll require peering + restricted egress rules. Any risks with pre-provisioned burst nodes we should call out in the SOW?

Proposed numbers (from pricing_matrix_cardinal_v2.xlsx):
- Reserved baseline (6 nodes): $72,000/mo (list)
- Burst reserve (3 nodes) during spike: $18,000/mo reservation + overage $2.50/token equivalent (detail in spreadsheet)
- One-time SOW services (network config & canary cutover): $12,500 (estimate)

Timelines: we need to lock terms by 2027-05-03 to hit a 5/17 cut. Procurement will want the proration examples by COB this week.

Thanks — please reply with approvals or edits.

Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cardinal Bio renewal — need pricing approval & SE check (env fork + burst)

All —

I’m ok with a 7% concession on the reserved 12-mo portion (6 nodes) plus Net45 payment terms and a small onboarding credit ($7,500) applied to the SOW fee. Rationale: strong product fit, likely expansion in H2. Keep the SLA uplift at 15% for guaranteed burst — don’t give that away.

Kimberly — please confirm the network implementation notes and any runbook changes required. If SE confirms risk is low, I’ll approve moving forward and let Soojin send the amended SOW + DocuSign.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Tran <ellie.tran@cardinalbio.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cardinalbio.com>, Cardinal Bio Procurement <procurement@cardinalbio.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Cardinal Bio — updated MAP, pricing, and DocuSign link

Ellie / Samir / Procurement team —

Per our internal approvals: summary and immediate asks to close by 2027-05-03 so we can cut the new environment 2027-05-17.

Approved commercial terms: 7% concession on the 12-mo reserved portion (6 nodes), onboarding credit $7,500 against SOW, Net45 payment terms. SLA uplift for guaranteed burst pool remains at +15% if you opt in.

Action items for Cardinal bio:
- Confirm whether you accept split commit (6 nodes reserved / remainder PAYGO) or prefer full-reserve for the analytics env. Reply by 2027-05-03.
- Sign the SOW addendum and order form: DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/DocuSign/link/abc123-cardinal
- Provide the final peering network block and egress policy by 2027-05-06. We’ll validate on our side and schedule the canary cutover for week of 2027-05-17.

Attached: Cardinal_SOW_env-fork_v1.pdf (amended with concession notes), pricing_matrix_cardinal_v2.xlsx, proposed_network_diagram.png

If you’d like, Ben and I can join procurement call Thurs 4/22 10am PT — confirm and I will send calendar invite.

Best,
So
Soojin Lee
Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Cardinal_SOW_env-fork_v1.pdf (SOW draft), pricing_matrix_cardinal_v2.xlsx (pricing), proposed_network_diagram.png (network sketch)
